ns2:section.sectionText: This course is restricted to junior, senior and graduate students in ENGINEERING. All other students register under CHEM 494. This class meets only FIVE times each semester. The drop deadlines and refund percentages are different for this course. Please review at https://registrar.illinois.edu/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/Nonstandard_course_refund_guide.pdf ***FIRST CLASS MEETS ON SEPTEMBER 9, 2019***
